basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old from Columbus, Ohio, who recently discovered the world of Reddit. During the weekdays, I work as a line cook at a local BBQ joint, which fuels my passion for all things smoked and grilled. When I'm not cooking up a storm, you can find me jamming to Slipknot or hanging out with my buddies, sharing a pizza and some laughs. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and late nights after my shift. I'm currently single and live with my two cats, who are my partners in crime.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I didn't go to college, but I've learned a lot about cooking and food safety through hands-on experience at work. My interest in music, particularly metal bands like Slipknot, comes from attending concerts and sharing playlists with friends. I also have a growing interest in firearms, specifically the Grand Power Stribog, which I discovered through online forums.
